summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only e2e verification of the multi-page feature. All 15 flows from the review request passed against the public preview URL: (1) layout-full with 5 imgs -> 5 hojas, each con exactly 1 placement [1,1,1,1,1]. (2) layout-half with 7 imgs -> 4 hojas [2,2,2,1]. (3) layout-2x2 with 9 imgs -> 3 hojas [4,4,1]. (4) layout-3x3 with 12 imgs -> 2 hojas [9,3]. (5) layout-4x4 with 20 imgs -> 2 hojas [16,4]. (6) layout-auto with 9 imgs stays UNA hoja con cuadricula 3x3 (excepcion correcta). (7) Modo INE + 4 imgs -> 2 hojas [2,2] tras activar ine-mode-toggle y click layout-ine. (8) page-wrapper-0..4 todos presentes con canvas-area scrollable (scrollHeight 5008 > clientHeight 1024). (9) export-pdf-button con 3 hojas dispara toast 'PDF de 3 hojas exportado' (~1.5s). (10) export-png-button con 3 hojas dispara toast '3 PNG exportados' (~2s). (11) Drag interno de miniatura (con application/x-image-id) sobre canvas-workspace-1 anade un placement con pageIndex=1 (page-1 count: 1->2). (12) OS drop de archivo PNG sobre canvas-workspace funciona, anade miniatura y placement. (13) Miniaturas usan img.thumb comprimido (1339 chars frente a 29278 chars del original PNG 1200x800). (14) Modo guillotina aplica borde dashed rgb(139,92,246) en TODAS las hojas (3/3 verified). (15) clear-canvas-button (Vaciar hojas) limpia placements pero conserva miniaturas; clear-all-button limpia ambos. Zero console errors across the full run.
critical_code_review_comments: Canvas.jsx onDropToPage line 75: Math.max(0, Math.min(70, xPct - 15)) still hardcodes the 30% width assumption (same comment from iter 1 & 2 - not addressed). When dropping a thumbnail at the bottom-right of a sheet, the placement clamps awkwardly because wPct=30 is constant. Recommend: const halfW = wPct/2; xPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100-wPct, x - halfW)). This affects multi-page drops as well now.

Canvas.jsx line 142: sheetRefs.current[pageIndex] = el assigns inside render via ref callback, but there is no cleanup when numPages shrinks (e.g. switching from 5 hojas to 1). Stale refs at higher indices remain in the array. getSheetNodes() filters Boolean so it works in practice, but when a removed DOM element is GC'd the ref entry becomes null - cleaner to slice the array to numPages length after each render.

PrinterContext.dropImagesAt: The pageIndex parameter is correctly propagated to the new placement, but the same xPct/yPct cascading offset (i*2) is applied regardless of which page the drop targets. If user drops 3 files on page 3, all three end up offset relative to drop coord on page 3 - this is correct, but the file order across multiple pages of a multi-drop is not supported (you can only drop one batch to one page at a time, which is fine).

layouts.js auto preset: when totalImages > cellsPerPage for auto-fit (e.g. 26 imgs would need 5x5=25 cells), the extra image is silently dropped (count = Math.min(images.length, cellsPerPage)). Consider showing a warning toast or extending to 2 pages. Not a regression but worth noting.

Header.jsx doExport: when exportGuillotine differs from guillotine, it toggles state then awaits 80ms before exporting - this is racy if the user clicks export twice quickly. Already protected by exporting.current ref, OK.

Sonner toasts auto-dismiss in ~4s. The toast container uses very low contrast text on white-ish bg (see screenshots: 'Lienzo limpiado' barely visible). Minor design nit - consider richColors prop or darker text.

RightSidebar: no data-testid on the file-input wrapper drop zone (only on the hidden input itself). For automated drag tests this is fine but for users dragging onto the left sidebar it may not be discoverable. Minor.
seed_data_creation: PNG data URLs generated at runtime via canvas.toBlob (200x200 colored squares, plus one 1200x800 for thumb-compression test). Injected via (a) file-input.files with DataTransfer for normal upload and (b) DragEvent with dataTransfer.items.add(File) on canvas-workspace[-N] for OS-style drop and internal thumb-drag (with setData 'application/x-image-id'). No persistence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-page works flawlessly. Key data-testids: layout-full (new), layout-{auto|half|2x2|3x3|4x4|ine}, page-count (text='N hoja|hojas'), page-wrapper-0..N-1, canvas-workspace (sheet 0), canvas-workspace-N (N>0), canvas-area (the scrolling container - scrollable when numPages>=2), canvas-placement, image-thumbnail-item, ine-mode-toggle, export-button (must click first to open dropdown), export-pdf-button, export-png-button, export-jpg-button, clear-all-button (uses window.confirm - register dialog handler), clear-canvas-button (no confirm). For internal drag use setData('application/x-image-id', imageId) where imageId comes from data-testid='image-thumbnail-item' element's dragstart event (the dataset.imageId attribute is NOT exposed, but the onDragStart handler does set it - so to capture, dispatch dragstart on the thumb and read dataTransfer.getData). For toast verification use a MutationObserver because Sonner auto-dismisses in ~4s; toast 'PDF de N hojas exportado' arrives ~1.5s after click; '3 PNG exportados' arrives ~2s after click. PDF/PNG export actually works in headless (jsPDF + html2canvas) - the toast IS the success indicator. canvas-area is the scrolling container with overflow-auto; each sheet is fixed pixel size so when N pages are stacked vertically, scrollHeight grows linearly.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All 15 review-request flows pass on first verification (after fixing two transient test-script issues: file-input is intentionally hidden so use state='attached'; Sonner toasts auto-dismiss in ~4s so use MutationObserver-based capture instead of single-shot query).
